reviews.title: Slightly older, but still holds up
reviews.comment: It's a pretty great GPU that holds up even today. I've been running on it for the past 3+ months, and it's been good for the most part. One moderate issue that I've found is that when on strenuous use, the temperature can get high; e.g. when playing RE4 Remake on higher settings, the temp reached around 80 °C after a while. It helps to have several fans (front, top, and back) in addition to a AIO cooling pump, but still. As far as the price, I researched extensively and this was pretty much the best price I could find WITH a fair return policy and an acceptable/desired delivery time. So while it's still a bit high, even though it's refurbished (which wasn't an issue, it was well-packaged and in near excellent condition), it was the pretty much the lowest you'll find for this card. Overall, it's been worth it.

reviews.title: Janky shipping updates part is perfect
reviews.comment: The shipping was Janky. I ordered it. It said it would be here the next day. The next day it said out for delivery, but under the status, it never shipped. And then later that night it said it was running late, but will be here tomorrow. Then it said it’s out for delivery but will be delivered by October 6. Today when I woke up and went from October 6 to October 9 and it actually delivered. The only reason I knew it was coming is because I got a notification saying that it was eight stops away. So the shipping can be Janky  at times. Packaging looked great. It was in a brown box that was stout and a UPS shipping box with ESD bag on it and foam on the inside really sturdy. The box was slightly smaller in height than the component, but that was because of the foam also it gave it a better secure fit so it wasn’t sliding around banging on the sides. I appreciated that. When I got home, I took out my 3050 and put in my 37 TI when I examine the part it looked brand new. There was no dust. It was really clean. All the fans worked performance mode and quiet mode worked. I just replaced my power supply with a Montech 1050 W 80+ gold. Centron 2. Way over killed for my build, but I got that power supply for future proof. Next is gonna be arising. Ryzen 7  5800x3d  and a AIO two fan liquid cooler after that I should be  set and next year I’ll start building a more modern gaming rig
